mapper.insert: insert into crm_customer_account_flow (flow_no, account_id, customer_id, biz_type, biz_id, biz_no, direction, amount, balance_before, balance_after, bill_id, bill_no, contract_id, remark, operator, create_time) values (#{flowNo}, #{accountId}, #{customerId}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{bizNo}, #{direction}, #{amount}, #{balanceBefore}, #{balanceAfter}, #{billId}, #{billNo}, #{contractId}, #{remark}, #{operator}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select id, flow_no, account_id, customer_id, biz_type, biz_id, biz_no, direction, amount, balance_before, balance_after, bill_id, bill_no, contract_id, remark, operator, create_time from crm_customer_account_flow where biz_type = #{bizType} and biz_id = #{bizId} limit 1

select id, flow_no, account_id, customer_id, biz_type, biz_id, biz_no, direction, amount, balance_before, balance_after, bill_id, bill_no, contract_id, remark, operator, create_time from crm_customer_account_flow where account_id = #{accountId} order by id desc limit 1
